justification: Both surfaces depict a single, richly costumed standing figure that fills the whole tall panel, with one arm raised/bent and the other lowered holding an object, plus elaborate head adornment — a broadly comparable 'single dignitary in relief' scheme. But the specifics diverge sharply: A shows a frontal human figure with a towering plumed headdress, dense jewellery, a masked basal platform and columns of sign-blocks, while B shows a strict profile bird-headed winged being with a plain fringed skirt, feathered wings and no accompanying signs, and the rendering conventions (dense allover ornament versus clean outlined naturalistic anatomy) are unrelated.
